hero.title: Transform Your Business with
hero.description: Expert consulting for data engineering, machine learning, and cloud infrastructure. We help enterprises unlock the power of their data.

methodology.title: From Strategy to Scale in Weeks
methodology.description: We don't sell open-ended consulting. We deploy a venture-building protocol designed to take you from a raw idea to a production-grade AI asset. Fast, secure, and sovereign.

01.title: The Blueprint & Audit
01.subtitle: De-Risking the Innovation
01.description: Before we write a single line of code, we validate the ecosystem. We assess your data readiness, security governance, and cloud foundations.

02.title: The MVP Sprint
02.subtitle: The Startup Engine
02.description: We activate startup mode with rapid iterations, weekly demos, and a focus on business value. Building a functional, secure MVP on your tenant.

03.title: Industrialization
03.subtitle: From Lab to Factory
03.description: A PoC is not a product. We harden the system for scale: MLOps pipelines, automated CI/CD, observability, and knowledge transfer.

techStack.title: Enterprise AI Stack
techStack.subtitle: Production Ready
techStack.description: A layered architecture designed for production AI at enterprise scale. Each layer is independently scalable, replaceable, and optimized for specific responsibilities.

1.title: User-Facing Intelligence
1.description: Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, and Arize AI observability create a seamless interface for enterprise-grade AI applications.

2.title: Corporate Memory & Grounding
2.description: Semantic Kernel orchestration, Azure AI Search for vector retrieval, and Databricks Unity Catalog for governance ensure your AI stays grounded in organizational data.

3.title: Reasoning Engines
3.description: Azure OpenAI GPT-4o, Mistral AI for sovereign models, and LiteLLM for model routing provide decoupled, swappable reasoning capabilities.

4.title: Enterprise Foundation
4.description: Azure Kubernetes Service, Terraform for infrastructure-as-code, and Azure Key Vault provide secure, scalable, sovereign infrastructure.
